description: This source file implements utility functions for the prplMesh project, specifically for converting network node, statistics, and event data structures into human-readable strings. It includes functions for serializing node info, stats, and events, and references external utilities and network-related headers.

methods.name: bml_utils_node_to_string
methods.description: Converts a BML_NODE structure into a human-readable string and copies it into a buffer.

methods.name: bml_utils_stats_to_string
methods.description: Serializes BML_STATS structure into a formatted string for display.

methods.name: bml_utils_stats_to_string_raw
methods.description: Serializes BML_STATS structure into a raw, comma-separated string.

methods.name: bml_utils_event_to_string
methods.description: Converts a BML_EVENT structure into a human-readable string based on event type.
